senses.gloss: (cmp. אֶרֶס) to be bitter.—V. מוֹר, מַר, מָרוֹר &c.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:5">Pes. X, 5</cite> <he>מרור על שום שמֵרְרוּ המצרים וכ׳</he> we eat bitter herbs in memory of the Egyptians embittering the lives of our fathers in Egypt.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:13:1">Cant. R. to I, 13</cite> (play on <cite ref="M02475"><he>מֹר</he></cite>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:13:1">ib.</cite>) <he>אברהם מְמָרֵר עצמו וכ׳</he> Abraham afflicted himself and plagued himself with sufferings; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6">ib. to III, 6</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> (play on <he>וימררהו</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:23">Gen. XLIX, 23</cite>) <he>שה׳ לאחיו</he> who made his brothers suffer; <he>שהֵמֵירוּ לו אחיו</he> whom his brothers made suffer; <he>שה׳ לאדונתו</he> who made his mistress suffer; <he>שהֵמֵירָה לו אדונתו</he> (v. Matt. K.) whom his mistress made suffer.

<cite ref="Shabbat 88b:4">Sabb. 88ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>צ̇ר̇ר המ̇ר̇</he>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 1:13">Cant. I, 13</cite>) <he>אע״פ שמיצ̇ר̇ ומֵימַ֗ר̇ לי וכ׳</he> although my Beloved decrees anguish and suffering for me; a. e.

senses.gloss: to become sticky and bitter from handling myrrh.
units: Cant. R. to I, 13 כל … ידיו מִתְמָרְרוֹת (Matt. K. מִתְמוֹרְר׳, Hithpol.) whoever plucks it (myrrh), gets his hands sticky (and bitter).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:15">Num. R. s. 13</cite> (play on <cite ref="M00639"><he>מוֹרִי</he></cite>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 5:1">Cant. V, 1</cite>) <he>נִתְמָרְרוּ בגלות וכ׳</he> they became bitter (affected with sin) in captivity, and were sweetened (atoned for their sins) by martyrdom.

senses.gloss: , Nithpalp. נִתְמַרְמֵר to get excited (in battle); to be enraged.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 29:1">Pesik. R. s. 29-30</cite>-30 (ed. Fr., p. 140ᵃ) <he>מיד היה מִתְמַרְמֵר וכ׳</he> at once he became enraged and kicked it (the missile) &c.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 29:1">Ib.</cite> <he>נתמ׳ לצאת</he> he was excited in rushing out.
